    About Tiny Meteora

    An isometric pixel-art atlas of Kalampaka, Kastraki, and the Meteora monasteries.

    Sources and credits

    The cliffs follow Fotis Giagkas’s 2016 photogrammetry, and mapped building footprints anchor the roofs. The outer valley uses public elevation data.

    Schoolyards, squares, the Town Hall fountain, and the stadium are drawn from mapped features. Google Satellite was used as a visual reference for the town’s surfaces and landmarks.

    House roof colors and shapes were refined using a November 2015 aerial survey. Source: Includes solar data from Google.

    Inspired by Tiny London, Tiny Rio, Isometric NYC, Tiny Utrecht and the Tiny World atlas.
